#include <iostream>

int main()
{
	const int size = 5;
	int arr[size];
	int n, sum = 0;
	std::cin >> n;
	for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
	{
		std::cin >> arr[i];
		sum = sum + arr[i];
	}
	std::cout << sum / n;
	return 0;
}
